evals.prompt: 这个仓库的测试挂了。先别急着改，帮我查清楚根因，再修掉，并留下能复现它的测试。项目在 buggy-cart/。
evals.expected_output: 被指名的具体根因（折扣按第一件商品的金额判断，而不是购物车小计）、来自真实运行的证据、修复后全套测试通过，以及一条覆盖多件商品的回归测试。
assertions: The final message names the specific root cause: the discount is decided from the first line item's amount instead of the cart subtotal
The root cause is supported by evidence quoted from an actual test or command run
The transcript shows the failing test was observed before any source file was edited
src/cart.js now decides the discount from the cart subtotal
test/cart.test.js contains a regression test for a multi-item cart whose subtotal qualifies for the discount

evals.prompt: 同事问这个购物车的折扣为什么算错。你把根因和证据整理一段话给他，先别动代码。
evals.expected_output: 一段能直接转发的说明：具体根因、支撑它的实际运行证据，并且没有修改任何源码文件。
assertions: The final message explains the root cause well enough for a teammate to act on it
The cited evidence comes from an actual run rather than from reading the code alone
src/cart.js still contains the original discount calculation from the first line item
